description: Defines the VariableViewModel class and related event args for managing variable properties in a calculator app, including property change notifications and localization.

classes.name: VariableViewModel
classes.description: A sealed class implementing INotifyPropertyChanged for variable properties in the calculator's view model, supporting property change notifications, event handling, and localization.

methods.name: VariableViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view model with a variable name and variable object.

methods.name: Min
methods.description: Property getter and setter for the minimum value of the variable, adjusting Max if necessary.

methods.name: Step
methods.description: Property getter and setter for the step value of the variable.

methods.name: Max
methods.description: Property getter and setter for the maximum value of the variable, adjusting Min if necessary.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property getter and setter for the current value of the variable, raising events and adjusting Min/Max as needed.

methods.name: VariableAutomationName
methods.description: Property getter returning a localized automation name for the variable.
